skills.name: Bring It On!
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. DEF ▲ 1.93% continuously for every 1% of HP lost. ■ Activates after landing 5 normal attacks while weapon is changed. Affects the target. Deals 25.95% of final ATK as additional damage.

skills.name: Leave It To Me!
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when firing the final bullet. Affects the 3 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK. Taunts for 4 sec. ■ Activates when HP falls below 20%. Affects self. Effects vary according to the number of uses. Perseverance: Only one effect is triggered at a time. Once: Max HP ▲ 55% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle. Twice: Max HP ▲ 36.09% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle. Three Times: Max HP ▲ 25.78% for 3 sec. Activates once per battle.
